rationale: Price is at 97.1% of today's range and within 0.24% of the session high after a large intraday move from $11.42 to $12.43, placing it in an extended, overbought position with minimal reward-to-risk for a long entry. A short at this level is tempting given the proximity to the high, but the last 1-minute candle showed a surge in volume (39K shares) closing near the high at $12.43, suggesting residual buying pressure that could push to new highs and invalidate a short quickly. With today's realized P&L already negative and no news catalyst to anchor a directional thesis, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
